query:
-- Resumo de vendas do mês
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas,
  SUM(valorColetado) as total_coletado,
  SUM(valorFaturado) as total_faturado,
  SUM((valorColetado - COALESCE(custoServico, 0)) * COALESCE(comissaoPercent, 10) / 100) as total_comissao
FROM vendas 
WHERE cancelado = 0 AND MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(createdAt/1000)) = 3 AND YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(createdAt/1000)) = 2026;

-- Parcelas do mês
SELECT 
  p.id, p.numeroParcela, p.valorParcela, p.dataVencimento, p.okConsultor, p.formaPagamento,
  v.clienteNome
FROM parcelas p
JOIN vendas v ON p.vendaId = v.id
WHERE v.cancelado = 0
ORDER BY p.dataVencimento;

-- Previsão futura de parcelas
SELECT 
  MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(dataVencimento/1000)) as mes,
  YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(dataVencimento/1000)) as ano,
  COUNT(*) as qtd_parcelas,
  SUM(valorParcela) as total_previsto
FROM parcelas p
JOIN vendas v ON p.vendaId = v.id
WHERE p.okConsultor = 0 AND v.cancelado = 0
GROUP BY YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(dataVencimento/1000)), MONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(dataVencimento/1000))
ORDER BY ano, mes;
